description.value: El Guapo is a lively Yaletown restaurant serving SoCal and BC West Coast-inspired cuisine, with a menu spanning brunch, lunch, dinner, and happy hour anchored by their signature margaritas. The space is designed to feel welcoming to all comers, with live music every weekend and big-screen sports coverage including FIFA matches near BC Place. Dishes range from Huevos Rancheros at brunch to Carnitas Tacos at happy hour, with delivery available through Uber Eats and DoorDash.
